about: The secreta of the formulary “Annunciation of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Fix firmly in our minds, O Lord, we beseech You, the mysteries of the true faith; that we who believe Him, conceived of a Virgin, to be true God and man, may be found worthy to reach eternal happiness through the power of His redeeming resurrection. Through the same Jesus Christ, our Lord, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,

a.g: we may deserve to attain everlasting joy

ex.w027: After “ut,” “mereámur” takes the infinitive “perveníre”: “that we may deserve to attain.” Both verbs stand between “ad ætérnam” and “lætítiam,” which belong together: “to everlasting joy.”
